minimum_result: CCA must be PARITY or IMPROVEMENT for every applicable inherited capability

capabilities.name: Layer-0 native entry routing
capabilities.must_test: Native CLAUDE.md entry semantics and task routing

capabilities.name: Root CONTEXT routing
capabilities.must_test: Root router sends tasks to correct stage without embedding reference content

capabilities.name: Stage CONTEXT routing
capabilities.must_test: Stage contract controls task scope and loading

capabilities.name: Selective section loading
capabilities.must_test: Load exact sections when full reference is unnecessary

capabilities.name: Exact Inputs contract
capabilities.must_test: Source | File/Location | Section/Scope | Why columns

capabilities.name: Output handoff
capabilities.must_test: Stage N output is human-editable and consumed by downstream stage

capabilities.name: One-way references
capabilities.must_test: Detect/prevent circular dependency

capabilities.name: Canonical single home
capabilities.must_test: Resolve duplicate authoritative facts to one source plus pointers

capabilities.name: CONTEXT routing purity
capabilities.must_test: Move substantive rule/example content out of router

capabilities.name: Tool prerequisites
capabilities.must_test: Required system tool gets install and verification guidance at correct scope

capabilities.name: setup trigger
capabilities.must_test: Run native onboarding rather than treating setup as ordinary prose

capabilities.name: status trigger
capabilities.must_test: Derive COMPLETE/PENDING from real output artifacts; placeholder-only files such as .gitkeep do not count

capabilities.name: Questionnaire flatness
capabilities.must_test: Single numbered list with no category groupings

capabilities.name: All-at-once onboarding
capabilities.must_test: Questions can be answered in one user message

capabilities.name: Derive don't ask
capabilities.must_test: Infer dependent fields instead of asking redundant questions

capabilities.name: Sensible defaults
capabilities.must_test: Questions provide useful default/example where meaningful

capabilities.name: Ask once persistence
capabilities.must_test: Successful setup is not repeated without reset/reconfigure

capabilities.name: Placeholder substitution
capabilities.must_test: Hydrate SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE placeholders across workspace

capabilities.name: Orphan placeholder detection
capabilities.must_test: Detect unresolved placeholders and questions with no consumers

capabilities.name: Conditional stages
capabilities.must_test: Optional stages/sections follow explicit conditions and are removed when disabled

capabilities.name: Skill discovery
capabilities.must_test: Discover relevant available domain skills when allowed

capabilities.name: Skill bundling
capabilities.must_test: Selected skill is self-contained, referenced, and replaces duplicate custom reference material

capabilities.name: Specs as contracts
capabilities.must_test: Specification defines WHAT/WHEN and rejects implementation HOW leakage

capabilities.name: Creative checkpoints
capabilities.must_test: Applicable creative stage pauses at useful human steering boundary

capabilities.name: Stage audits
capabilities.must_test: Applicable creative/build stage has specific pass/fail audit before output

capabilities.name: Value validation
capabilities.must_test: Applicable content workflow evaluates value before/within production

capabilities.name: Docs over outputs
capabilities.must_test: Stable reference wins over contradictory prior generated artifact

capabilities.name: Shared constants
capabilities.must_test: Configurable code values have one canonical shared home

capabilities.name: Naming conventions
capabilities.must_test: Native naming and zero-padded stage rules are detected/enforced

capabilities.name: Native quality guardrails
capabilities.must_test: Current upstream size/style/format acceptance catches deliberate violations

capabilities.name: Cold-agent walk
capabilities.must_test: Fresh agent orients, acts, and reports without chat memory

capabilities.name: Build workflow
capabilities.must_test: Create smallest valid native workspace from a workflow description

capabilities.name: Restructure workflow
capabilities.must_test: Audit/classify, verify reference integrity, propose for approval, migrate recoverably, and preserve expected references

capabilities.name: Factory/product distinction
capabilities.must_test: Stable Layer-3 constraints remain distinct from changing Layer-4 artifacts

capabilities.name: Workspace-builder end-to-end
capabilities.must_test: Discovery -> mapping -> scaffolding -> questionnaire -> validation/repair -> setup -> status -> fresh-agent use

capabilities.name: Human-edited handoff
capabilities.must_test: Downstream stage consumes a human-edited upstream output, not stale chat state

capabilities.name: Stale authority repair
capabilities.must_test: Repair contradiction between stable docs and old outputs without promoting output to authority

capabilities.name: Broken route repair
capabilities.must_test: Detect and repair missing routed file while preserving contract semantics

capabilities.name: Native contribution boundary
capabilities.must_test: Distinguish building a compatible workspace from satisfying an upstream repository contribution process

capabilities.name: Progressive disclosure
capabilities.must_test: Complete task with minimum sufficient routed context; record files/references/tokens loaded

capabilities.name: Pre-move reference integrity
capabilities.must_test: Before proposing a move, enumerate in-workspace, sibling-relative, symlink, and bounded known external referrers; apparent disuse is not move-safety evidence

capabilities.name: Case-fold destination collision
capabilities.must_test: Detect a destination that aliases an existing path under case-folding before copy or rename

capabilities.name: Copy-verify-remove migration
capabilities.must_test: Copy substantive existing content, verify parity, then remove the source only after verification and referrer preservation

capabilities.name: Inbound external consumers
capabilities.must_test: System Map reverse walk identifies bounded known consumers outside the mapped tree that point into mapped objects
